llms.txt

This file lists the most useful entry points for LLMs.
Replace example.com with your real domain.

[Documentation]
- https://example.com/docs
- https://example.com/api

[API]
- Base URL: https://example.com/api/v1
- OpenAPI: https://example.com/api/openapi.json

[Examples]
- https://example.com/api/examples

[Policies]
- https://example.com/robots.txt
- https://example.com/privacy

[Contact]
- https://example.com/contact
